ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure gives three structures, and uses curved arrows to mark the C=C bonds whose rotational barriers are to be compared. (I) is CH2=CH2; (II) is CH3O–CH=CH2; (III) is CH3O–CH=CH–C(=O)OEt. Reasoning: Rotation about a C=C bond requires weakening or breaking the π bond, so the rotational barrier increases as the effective double-bond character of this bond increases. In (II), the methoxy group can donate electrons by resonance with the alkene, making the effective bond order of C=C lower than that of an ordinary alkene; in (III), electron donation by the methoxy group and electron withdrawal by the ester carbonyl together form a stronger push-pull conjugated system, the charge-separated resonance contribution is larger, and the effective double-bond character of C=C is weaker, so its rotational barrier is lower than that of (II). Therefore the relative-order fragment required by the problem is > II > III.

raw_record.question_text: What is the correct order of rotation barrier about the $C = C$ bond, as indicated?

method.method_draft: First identify the indicated C=C bond in each drawn structure. Compare the degree of pi-bond/double-bond character: ethene (I) has an unsubstituted normal C=C and therefore the strongest pi bond and highest rotation barrier. In (II), the methoxy group donates by resonance into the alkene, producing polar resonance forms and lowering the C=C bond order, so its rotation barrier is lower than I. In (III), methoxy donation is combined with conjugation to the electron-withdrawing ester carbonyl, giving a push-pull alkene with the greatest charge-separated resonance contribution and the weakest effective C=C bond, so it has the lowest barrier. Therefore the order is I > II > III.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中有三个结构，均用弯箭头标出需要比较旋转势垒的 C=C 键。(I) 是 CH2=CH2，即乙烯；(II) 是 CH3O-CH=CH2，即甲氧基取代的烯烃；(III) 是 CH3O-CH=CH-C(=O)OEt，即一端有甲氧基给电子基、另一端与酯羰基共轭的烯烃。推理：绕 C=C 键旋转需要破坏 π 键，因此旋转势垒主要随该 C=C 的有效双键性增强而增大。(I) 的乙烯是普通未取代 C=C，π 键双键性最强，旋转势垒最高。(II) 中甲氧基可以通过共振向烯烃供电子，形成一定的极性共振式，使 C=C 键级下降，因此势垒低于 (I)。(III) 中甲氧基供电子与酯羰基吸电子共同作用，形成 push-pull alkene，共振电荷分离贡献最大，C=C 有效双键性最弱，因此旋转势垒最低。所以正确顺序为 I > II > III。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: Uses substituent electronic effects and resonance-derived C=C bond order as the direct criterion for the rotation barrier; this is the natural single route for this image-grounded organic chemistry comparison.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the three indicated alkenes from the image: (I) ethene, CH2=CH2; (II) a vinyl ether, CH3O-CH=CH2; and (III) a push-pull substituted alkene, CH3O-CH=CH-C(=O)OEt. Note that the curved arrows mark rotation about the C=C bond in each case.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the question text only to know the requested property: the order of rotation barrier about the indicated C=C bond.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Rotation about a C=C bond requires loss of pi overlap, so the barrier is higher when the C=C has stronger double-bond character. Electron-donating substituents such as -OCH3 can delocalize into the alkene and reduce pure C=C double-bond character; a donor plus an electron-withdrawing carbonyl ester creates stronger push-pull resonance, giving even more single-bond character and the lowest barrier.
